general_information.name: OH—RIGHT, MY NAME IS MICHAEL O’ROURKE. THAT'S THE ONE ON THE DOCUMENTS, I THINK.
general_information.family_doctor_name: OH, THE DOCTOR’S NAME… I KNOW I HAVE ONE, YES, BUT I’M DRAWING A BLANK ON THE FULL NAME AT THE MOMENT. IT’S DR. LENA SOMETHING, I THINK, OR MAYBE I’M MIXING THAT UP WITH ANOTHER NAME. IF YOU ASK ME AGAIN I CAN TRY TO PIN IT DOWN BETTER.

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s mostly the sadness… missing my wife, really. She died about a year ago from cancer, and some days it comes in waves and I cry around anniversaries, but I’m still going to work and seeing friends, so… that’s the main thing.
current_concerns.goals: I just want to learn how to live with it, I suppose—keep going the way she would’ve wanted, and not get stuck.

past_psychiatric_history.previous_therapies: Yes, I did go to a bereavement group. It was through hospice, and I think it was in 2025… about eight sessions, if I’m remembering right.; 2025.; About 8 sessions.

medical_history.medical_conditions: Just the high cholesterol, and that was diagnosed back in 2016.

substance_use.nonmedical_alcohol_use: Status: Current; Substance or product: Beer.; Quantity or frequency: Two on weekends.; Duration: About forty years.

education_employment_legal_history.employment_history: Job 1: Name Or Description: Marchmont Consulting.; Job Title: Civil engineer.; Dates: 1991 to present.

personal_history.early_childhood: Born in Cork, moved to Toronto when I was 8… we were a warm family, that’s what I remember.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: I did an engineering degree, and honestly there weren’t any big difficulties that stand out. It was pretty straightforward, I guess.
personal_history.significant_relationships: Well, I’m widowed now. My wife and I were married for 33 years before she died. We’ve got two adult children nearby too, if that matters.
personal_history.future_goals: Keep working, see my grandchildren, and travel a little.
